La Victoria Panadería.note: Mission institution since the 1950s; pan dulce. (The old 2937 24th St storefront is closed — this is the open one.)

Arizmendi Bakery.note: Worker-owned co-op; scones, pizza slice of the day. Closed Tuesdays.

Boss Bakery.note: HK/Taiwanese breads and pastries, banh mi. Cash only.

Sol Bakery.note: Opened April 2026. Guava tart, croissants. Open Fri–Sun only; expect a line.

Hahdough.note: German bakery — Berliners, pretzels. Closed Mon–Tue; sells out early.

The Mill.note: VERIFY BEFORE YOU GO — their own site lists 7a–5p daily, but Yelp currently flags the listing as closed.

Wholesome Bakery.note: Gluten-free and vegan. VERIFY — Yelp flagged the listing closed in June 2026 while other listings show these hours.

Arsicault Bakery.note: Bon Appétit's best croissant in America. Arguello hours confirmed; the McAllister shop keeps similar hours — check before a long detour.

Schubert's Bakery.note: Open since 1911; German cakes. Closed Mon–Tue.

Wing Lee Bakery.note: Roast pork buns, curry puffs; very cheap. Cash only.

Rize Up Bakery.note: Black-owned sourdough specialist. Saturday only on weekends — Sunday runners should skip it.
